verdicts.reason: A drops the SOLSTICE sun logo and wordmark completely, so the banner loses its brand. Its CTA also wraps awkwardly onto two lines ('Shop the / Summer Line') and sits crammed against the right edge. B keeps the logo and a sensible left-to-right flow (brand, then headline, then CTA), but the SOLSTICE wordmark is too small to read and the CTA is tiny and tucked tight under the headline, with background dots near the text. B also leaves the middle of the banner empty.
